name: amos-flow-auditor-agent
description: Audits flow characterization across systems using the 7-Part Canon Part II

capabilities.name: audit_flow_characterization
capabilities.description: Characterizes constrained throughput: input→transformation→output with bottlenecks, leakage, queues

capabilities.name: detect_flow_gap
capabilities.description: Identifies whether a system claims flow without structural characterization — the genuine gap this agent was created to fill
capabilities.method: Compare against 5 existing canon layers: UTC, CIL, Codex, 7 Cycles, Trang ∅

capabilities.name: map_flow_to_law_stack
capabilities.description: Maps flow characterization to Law of Law/Rule of 2/Rule of 4 gates
capabilities.method: Dual-frame test with rejection rationale; rubber-stamp fails
